claim: Single wearables, watch out: Garmin is partner-approval-only.
quote: If approved, you will be granted access to the Garmin Developer Portal and can get started on your integration right away.

claim: Single wearables, watch out: by its own FAQ, Garmin's program is for business use only.
quote: There are no licensing or maintenance fees for access to the Garmin Connect Developer Program, but it is only for business use.

claim: Single wearables, watch out: Oura limits a new app to 10 users until Oura approves it.
quote: By default, API Applications have a ten user limit. If you want to release your application to a wider audience, your application needs to be approved.

claim: Single wearables, watch out: WHOOP starts every app on a Sandbox tier of 10 members.
quote: Every new app starts on the Sandbox tier, which allows up to 10 WHOOP members to connect.

claim: Single wearables, watch out: WHOOP requires developers to hold a WHOOP membership.
quote: You must have a WHOOP membership to develop an app on the Developer Platform. Your WHOOP account is also your WHOOP developer login.
